children: MONTRÉAL, Nov. 26, 2026 /CNW/ -- The Board of Directors of the Laurentian Bank of Canada (the "Bank") declared on November 25, 2026 a dividend of $0.38725 on the preferred shares Series 13 (
.PR.H), payable on December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 7, 2026.
The above-mentioned dividends are designated as eligible dividends for the purposes of the Income Tax Act (Canada) and any similar provincial and territorial legislation.
On August 28, 2026, the Bank announced that it has determined to terminate its Shareholder Dividend Reinvestment and Share Purchase Plan, effective September 30, 2026.
For more information, please contact Computershare Trust Company of Canada by phone at 1‑800‑564‑6253, by e-mail at
, or by mail at 650 De Maisonneuve West 7th floor, Montreal, QC H3A 3T2.

Founded in Montreal in 1846, Laurentian Bank is committed to serving its customers and fostering deep relationships with specialized groups. Laurentian Bank runs operations across Canada – primarily in Québec and Ontario – as well as in the United States and competes where it sees market opportunity and has an edge, while harnessing the power of partnerships and collaboration.
